findings.ai_insight: For Stripe, a leader in financial infrastructure, having zero citation share in AI-related web search matters because it may hinder the company's ability to attract new customers who increasingly rely on AI-driven search results to discover and evaluate payment solutions. ai_narrative:
Your AI search visibility score is 50, which means Stripe's website is moderately visible to AI-powered search engines. In plain terms, this score indicates that while your website can be found by AI search engines, there's room for improvement to increase its visibility and reach a wider audience. The single most critical gap is the lack of citations, scoring 0 out of 30, which refers to mentions of your business on other reputable websites, a key factor in establishing credibility and trust with AI search engines.

This gap is critical because citations help AI search engines understand your business's reputation and authority in the financial services industry. Without citations, your website may struggle to stand out from competitors and may not be displayed in search results as prominently. 

This week, prioritize reaching out to relevant financial industry partners or publications to request mentions of Stripe on their websites, which can help improve your citation score and overall AI search visibility.
